scientific_question: Does a narrow ranking-aligned adapter around the frozen Step-14 frame anchor scores recover downstream mechanism balanced accuracy by correcting candidate-frame ranking, without changing candidate generation or the frozen mechanism head?

frozen_components.candidate_mechanism_network: exactly frozen Step-14 three-way candidate network checkpoints; not retrained by Step-15
frozen_components.equivalence_kernel: exactly frozen Step-14 finite-frame pair geometry and tau
frozen_components.mechanism_smoothing: exactly frozen Step-14 equivalence-smoothed mechanism logits
frozen_components.classification_objective: retained in the frozen Step-14 mechanism head; Step-15 adds ranking supervision rather than replacing it

fit_positive_definition.geometry_source: FIT-only exact candidate/true-frame Born-response Jacobians used as labels only

inference_inputs: finite-shot frame evidence and kernel density
three finite-shot mechanism profile log-likelihoods and derived summaries
candidate qubit fraction and boundary fraction
adapter.listwise_loss: negative log posterior mass assigned to the FIT response-equivalent positive set
adapter.pairwise_loss: softplus margin against frozen-baseline top-scoring non-equivalent hard negatives
adapter.hard_negative_selection: fixed from frozen Step-14 baseline anchor score before adapter training

fit_only_family_cross_validation.fold_rule: first eight bytes of SHA256(family_id) interpreted as unsigned integer mod 3
selection_order: higher cross-fitted top1 response-equivalent candidate accuracy

zero_adapter_regression.contract: zero correction must call and exactly recover the frozen Step-14 equivalence_aware_pool_one implementation
